observation.visible_scene: A stone-clad fireplace with a metal mesh screen across the opening, set on a stone hearth above a wooden floor. Inside the firebox, logs burn with a large, bright yellow-white flame filling the upper cavity. A paperback book stands upright at the center base of the firebox, in front of the flames. To the left is a metal rack against a white wall; to the right is a dark storage box on the hearth; a patterned rug edge appears at the bottom left.
visible_changes: The fire's flames flicker continuously: the shape, height and brightness of the flame tongues vary from frame to frame, with the intense white glow at the top pulsing and the side flames (left and right of the log pile) rising and receding.
The logs, the standing book, the screen, the hearth and the surrounding objects remain in fixed positions with no translation or deformation visible across the segment.
The camera framing is essentially static; the relative positions of the fireplace, the left rack and the right box do not shift, so observed changes are confined to the fire itself.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the standing book is being intentionally burned or placed there, and what happens to it outside this excerpt.
How the fire was started and whether it will continue, grow or die down after the clip ends.
uncertain_details: The exact title/text on the book cover is not legible.
Minor possible camera jitter cannot be fully distinguished from the strong light flicker cast on the hearth and floor.
